metadata.sprint: MG0-B AlphaTrade Compatibility Audit + MarketGenome Scaffold

documents.role: MarketGenome design boundary and M12 interpretation

evidence_boundaries: Code locators establish current implementation behavior; one legacy control test imported JAX with a forced CPU backend, but no JAX computation/model runtime was executed in MG0-B.
M12 metrics are historical evidence read from the authoritative formal run and were not recomputed.
Compatibility classifications describe reuse boundaries, not implemented MarketGenome capabilities.
The untracked planning documents are user-provided inputs and are not part of this commit.

artifacts.role: Machine-readable leaderboard and M10/M11 quality evidence
M12 data-contract schema and semantic validation

m12_evidence.interpretation: M12 validates the engineering/data-contract path but rejects every processed-feature candidate for promotion. This neither proves model quality nor disproves the separate MarketGenome hypothesis.

evidence.claim: The reader applies manifest/date filters, sorting, EOB de-duplication, and base-column validation.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The reader reliably returns ordered OHLCV/OI bars from the existing archive contract.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse reading, filtering, ordering, and base validation; do not treat its returned frame as a complete long-sequence identity/availability contract.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Add identity, session, missingness, time-slot, source-version, and resolution metadata in a new dataset adapter.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Without explicit availability masks, zero-filled missing features become observationally indistinguishable from real zeros.

evidence.claim: Bars are joined to the trading-date continuous map using real contract symbols.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The pipeline stitches the mapped real contract for each trading date and audits switches in aggregate.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse authoritative contract selection and stitch ordering; aggregate switch counts are not sufficient as per-position model inputs.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Emit roll boundary, active contract identity, contract age, gap/session masks, and provenance tracks without modifying the current continuous-bar output.
compatibility_matrix.risk: An unmarked roll can be learned as a price motif or contaminate dense targets.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; dense roll tracks are not implemented.

evidence.claim: FeatureProfile records ordered columns, dimension, source schema, scaler, normalization, and fingerprint metadata.
Profile resolution and fingerprint checks are centralized and fail on mismatches.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: M12 already supports dynamic feature dimensions and train-only scaler provenance through typed profiles.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse ordered-column, scaler, normalization, and fingerprint contracts; the current profile lacks modality, resolution, identity, and availability-mask semantics.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Extend through a new MarketGenome profile adapter rather than changing existing M12 profiles.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Treating feature_dim as a sufficient schema would hide track modality and missingness differences.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; no claim that training is functionally fixed to eight features.

evidence.claim: The cache fixes four horizons globally.
It zero-fills non-finite values and materializes [N, lookback, F] plus [N, 4] arrays.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: Every sample is a fixed x_start/x_end window with four terminal-return labels and no explicit availability mask.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: The fingerprint and atomic-publication ideas may be re-applied, but the stored layout and loader contract must not be reused.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Create a separately versioned chunk store with timestamps, valid-position masks, per-track masks, identity, fold, and roll metadata in MG3.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Adapting the existing array shapes would silently retain the short-window/terminal-label task.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; no cache build or deletion executed.

evidence.claim: The current training store derives one lookback from the first sample and allocates fixed dense window arrays.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: No versioned long-chunk store or dense multi-track target container exists in the current AlphaTrade path.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: There is no existing storage implementation to claim as direct reuse.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Define storage only after MG1 ontology and MG3 track contracts, including chunk overlap and mask semantics.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Premature layout choices would freeze unresolved ontology and label alignment decisions.

evidence.claim: AlphaTradeConfig contains fixed-family defaults for lookback, architecture, horizons, and quantiles.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The core default is 4096/8 features/6 stages, while M12 launcher resolution supplies a 60-bar/two-stage v0.2 configuration.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Do not inherit AlphaTradeConfig or leak its defaults into MarketGenome; only reuse resolved-config hashing conventions.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Freeze a new config after ontology/track contracts and include its complete canonical payload/hash in every artifact.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Inheritance would make old short-window architecture behavior an implicit MarketGenome default.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; MG0-B config records scaffold state only.

evidence.claim: The launcher constructs the v0.2 horizons, quantiles, two-stage encoder, d_model, and transformer depth in code.
The M8 runner is wired to the M5 sweep, M7 regression report, and current profile validator commands.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The launcher is coupled to AlphaTrade model/loss/batches and terminal horizon targets, while the M8 runner is coupled to the M5/M7 command chain.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse the plan-run-report-strict-gate workflow only through a future MarketGenome-specific runner; do not add conditionals to current scripts.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Add an independent launcher after MG4 and make it require resolved config, data/ontology hashes, explicit backend, and strict resume identity.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Patching this launcher would alter M0-M12 behavior and preserve incompatible task semantics.

evidence.claim: The current trainer persists params, state, optimizer state, step, and best metric.
Sweep resume compares configuration and data identity before artifact reuse.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: State persistence is usable as a pattern, but direct M4 restore is not the complete fail-closed resume contract used by M5.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse atomic/state/provenance conventions; never load an AlphaTrade checkpoint into a MarketGenome module or share its format identity.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Define a new checkpoint version with config, dataset, ontology, track-schema, precision, and sharding fingerprints.
compatibility_matrix.risk: A structurally loadable checkpoint can still be semantically incompatible.

evidence.claim: Exporter hashes files and derives deterministic bundle identity.
The payload is explicitly alphatrade_model_bundle_v1 with v0.2/M9 schemas.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: Provenance/hash mechanisms are sound, while champion selection and payload identity are tied to M5/M9 AlphaTrade.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse hashing, safe paths, manifest integrity, and feature-profile consistency; keep the v1 schema immutable.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Create a new MarketGenome bundle format and export adapter only after model/checkpoint/output contracts exist.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Reusing the v1 name would make loaders accept a different model/output contract.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; no bundle generated in MG0-B.

evidence.claim: The loader constructs AlphaTradeConfig and the AlphaTrade model.
Prediction accepts fixed lookback windows and returns only terminal log-return quantiles.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The predictor and response schema are fixed-window AlphaTrade v0.2 interfaces.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Operational streaming/progress ideas can be adapted, but the model loader, input iterator, restore path, and output writer cannot be shared.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Add an independent chunk/dense-track predictor and an optional terminal-alpha handoff adapter later.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Wrapping dense outputs in the old wide schema would discard position, mask, and task identity.

evidence.claim: M10 implements pinball, coverage, and quantile-crossing kernels over canonical terminal-return rows.
M11 fits additive quantile residual calibration on validation data and preserves non-crossing.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The statistical kernels and common-row/past-only discipline are valid for semantically identical terminal-return quantile tracks.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse metric math after a versioned adapter; do not reuse wide-row alignment, q50 signal assumptions, historical thresholds, or closure conclusions for dense tasks.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Define task-specific evaluators and gates, with an optional adapter for a terminal return alpha head.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Current M10 strict validation has no semantic checks (0/0); schema PASS or a lightweight backtest can be mistaken for general model quality or trade readiness.
compatibility_matrix.verification: SOURCE_VERIFIED; historical M12 quality evidence confirms the distinction.

evidence.claim: Governance defines source-of-truth order, external run roots, and isolated profiles.
Generated reports default to an external sibling runs root.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: Schemas, required report pairs, external artifacts, and profile isolation are established repository contracts.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse the governance rules directly; use a separate MG0-B manifest because MG0-A freezes the legacy validator/manifest bytes at its tag.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Keep canonical audit sources in repo and generated validation/report copies under the external run root.
compatibility_matrix.risk: Editing the legacy manifest now would fail the frozen MG0-A 13/13 tag-anchor check.

evidence.claim: Sweep configurations receive a canonical SHA256 fingerprint.
Resume metadata mismatch and stale partial artifacts fail closed.

compatibility_matrix.observed_current_behavior: The M5 runner rejects reuse when config/data/universe/eval/checkpoint identity differs.
compatibility_matrix.reuse_boundary: Reuse fail-closed comparison and immutable baseline principles, not the M5-specific field set or runner.
compatibility_matrix.market_genome_action: Add ontology, track schema, resolved config, storage, model, precision, and distributed-layout hashes to a future runner.
compatibility_matrix.risk: A narrower resume identity can silently combine incompatible dense-task runs.

evidence.claim: The standardized convolution left-pads and takes only current/past inputs.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: The causal pattern is reusable, but MarketGenome requires valid-position/availability-mask behavior and separate namespace tests.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Prefix equivalence, future mutation, gap/session mask, and arbitrary chunk-length tests.

evidence.claim: Pooling left-pads non-divisible lengths.
Decoder repeats and right-crops to the skip length.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: Alignment behavior must be re-proven for arbitrary long chunks and dense output positions.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Impulse alignment at every remainder modulo each downsampling stage.

evidence.claim: Attention applies RoPE, soft-cap, then a negative-infinity causal mask before softmax.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: Current attention has no padding/session/roll/time-gap mask and uses implicit sequence positions.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Mask composition and actual-time position tests plus prefix/future-mutation invariance.

evidence.claim: The current trunk is a fixed encoder, transformer tower, and decoder driven by AlphaTradeConfig.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: MarketGenome architecture decisions remain unimplemented; the existing trunk is not a long-sequence backbone prototype.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: MG4 architecture, resolution, causality, and parameter-contract tests after MG2/MG3.

evidence.claim: All heads consume x[:, -1, :] and return batch-level horizon predictions.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: This readout conflicts directly with dense per-position supervision.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Dense output length/alignment/mask tests; no implicit terminal-only fallback.

evidence.claim: The head parameterizes a median with cumulative positive/negative softplus deltas.
Configuration requires an odd quantile count with 0.5 in the center.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: The ordering trick is specific to the current terminal quantile head and does not define dense multimodal outputs.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Task-specific head shapes, masks, calibration, and monotonicity tests after track freeze.

evidence.claim: The module implements pinball, crossing, and multi-horizon terminal losses.

architecture_boundaries.boundary: Primitive math can be reused for compatible quantile tracks; current horizon dict aggregation and defaults cannot represent masked dense multi-task losses.
architecture_boundaries.required_future_test: Masked reductions, empty-mask behavior, per-track weighting, and train-only scale tests.

evidence.claim: The operational launcher resolves one lookback value with a 60-bar default.

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: M12 used a fixed 60-bar window; this is an operational path fact, distinct from AlphaTradeConfig's 4096 default.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Use versioned long chunks with explicit context, overlap, valid positions, and resolution metadata.

evidence.claim: All required return heads consume only x[:, -1, :].

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: The current task emits one prediction vector per window rather than one or more dense tracks.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Replace with explicitly aligned dense heads; optional terminal alpha output must be an adapter.

evidence.claim: Each sample stores y_h1/y_h5/y_h20/y_h60 terminal returns in four scalar columns.

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: No per-position target values or target-specific masks are retained by the cache.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Define masked dense track targets after ontology/track freeze; never infer missingness from zero.

evidence.claim: The cache allocates fixed [N, lookback, F], [N, 4], and symbol arrays, including a hard-coded 60 length for empty data.

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: The layout cannot encode variable valid length, timestamps, folds, roll boundaries, or track-specific masks.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Replace the layout under a new schema/version; preserve the existing cache for M0-M12.

evidence.claim: Quantiles are produced as median plus cumulative signed deltas.
The configuration enforces the centered odd-quantile assumption.

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: Quantile values affect loss labels but not the head's interval parameterization; the head is not a general dense-track interface.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Specify heads per target modality and resolution after MG3; reuse pinball only where semantics match.

evidence.claim: The launcher fixes horizons, quantiles, two encoder stages, channel sizes, d_model, and transformer depth.
The public tensor contract remains typed around B L 8 inputs and horizon-level outputs.

incompatible_assumptions.confirmed_behavior: Feature dimension is dynamically passed by M12, but architecture/task choices and stale 8D annotations remain coupled to the AlphaTrade line.
incompatible_assumptions.market_genome_action: Keep a separate resolved config and schemas; do not conditionalize current core/launcher code.

metric_reuse.metric: Pinball loss, coverage MAE, and quantile crossing

evidence.claim: M10 computes these metrics from canonical realized/prediction rows.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: Terminal-return quantile tracks with identical units, horizons, valid-row masks, and quantile semantics.
metric_reuse.adapter: Convert a versioned MarketGenome terminal-alpha head into M10 canonical rows without changing current report fields.
metric_reuse.limitation: Not applicable to categorical pattern, barrier, path, range, volatility, MFE/MAE, or perturbation outputs.

metric_reuse.metric: Distribution summaries, Pearson/rank IC, and direction hit

evidence.claim: M10 computes distribution, IC, and direction metrics from terminal-return rows.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: Continuous scalar alpha outputs after common-row alignment.
metric_reuse.adapter: Select a declared terminal scalar/median track and preserve symbol/horizon grouping and masks.
metric_reuse.limitation: q50-based direction is not a universal summary for multimodal dense heads.

evidence.claim: Baseline availability and selection distinguish zero and past-only rolling quantile sources.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: Terminal-return targets where the historical window is causally defined.
metric_reuse.adapter: Recompute on the same fold/common rows as each compatible MarketGenome output.
metric_reuse.limitation: A rolling return baseline does not benchmark pattern phases, barriers, paths, or perturbation effects.

evidence.claim: The diagnostic derives q50/quantile signals and simplified costs/returns.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: Optional diagnostic for a terminal alpha handoff only.
metric_reuse.adapter: A future alpha adapter may call it without changing M10 output contracts.
metric_reuse.limitation: It is not an execution simulator, annualized promotion proof, or model-quality substitute.

evidence.claim: M11 fits calibration on validation data and applies ordered additive shifts.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: Diagnostic calibration for semantically equivalent terminal quantile tracks.
metric_reuse.adapter: Fit only on the declared validation fold and preserve train/test isolation.
metric_reuse.limitation: Current thresholds and the historical M11 closure conclusion do not transfer to MarketGenome.

evidence.claim: The checker encodes the historical output-scale, rolling-baseline, rejection, and next-M12 conclusion.

metric_reuse.valid_scope: The frozen AlphaTrade M11 closure only.
metric_reuse.adapter: Reuse the principle that schema/semantic validity and model quality are separate statuses.
metric_reuse.limitation: Do not reuse its fixed thresholds, milestone conclusion, or output-scale diagnosis as a MarketGenome gate.

preservation.rationale: MG0-A freezes the current validator, legacy manifest, and validator tests at tag mg0-a-alphagenome-parity-v1. MG0-B therefore uses an independent profile and validator under the new namespace, leaving every M0-M12 contract byte-for-byte unchanged.

uncertainties.item: Dynamic feature dimension versus stale B L 8 type annotations
uncertainties.evidence_gap: M12 passes feature_profile.feature_dim into the launcher, while core annotations still say eight; MG0-B did not execute JAX to probe runtime type behavior.
uncertainties.next_verification: Cover the new MG3 input schema independently and retain an explicit terminal-alpha adapter test.

uncertainties.item: Long-sequence chunk length, overlap, and storage format
uncertainties.evidence_gap: No current AlphaTrade implementation or frozen MarketGenome track contract determines these values.
uncertainties.next_verification: Resolve after MG1 ontology freeze and specify in MG3 with causality/alignment tests.

uncertainties.item: MarketGenome task metrics and promotion thresholds
uncertainties.evidence_gap: Current M10/M11 covers terminal-return quantiles but not path, barrier, pattern, dense range/volatility, MFE/MAE, or perturbation tasks.
uncertainties.next_verification: Freeze per-task metrics and fold-aware thresholds before MG5 learnability evaluation.

uncertainties.evidence_gap: The future model topology, precision, optimizer, and sharding coordinates do not exist in MG0-B.
uncertainties.next_verification: Define a versioned fail-closed contract with the MG4 trainer.

checks.name: compatibility_matrix_complete
checks.evidence: All 13 plan-listed subsystems have exact source-grounded boundaries.

checks.name: incompatible_assumptions_explicit
checks.evidence: All six mandatory incompatible assumptions are separately recorded.

checks.name: m12_statuses_not_conflated
checks.evidence: Engineering/schema PASS and model-quality/formal decision FAIL are separate fields.

checks.name: market_genome_import_safe
checks.evidence: The 19-test MG0-B suite confirms the package and placeholders import without JAX, Haiku, model, training, or GPU initialization.

checks.name: legacy_contracts_preserved
checks.evidence: The non-GPU AlphaTrade regression set passed 108 tests; frozen MG0-A strict remains schema 2/2 and semantic 13/13.

checks.name: independent_mg0b_schema_profile
checks.evidence: Strict mg0b validation passes schema 1/1 and semantic 14/14; manifest required artifacts pass 2/2.

checks.name: scaffold_only_scope
checks.evidence: No backbone, data pipeline, tensor model schema, training, inference, or evaluation implementation was added.

checks.name: training_and_gpu_deferred
checks.evidence: No training, inference, checkpoint, JAX computation, or GPU command ran. One legacy control test imported JAX under the forced CPU backend.
